reader.decision: Approve the allowlist in runner/spawn.py with the docs/plugin-contract.md sentence, in place of the two-name denylist addition. Also remove the env dump at plugins/feed-fetch/main.py:14 as a separate follow-up.
reader.decision_reason: The message gives the root cause as secrets leaking by default through a denylist, shows the two-name addition would still leak BILLING_WEBHOOK_SECRET, and states the allowlist covers every variable the plugins read. The cost is small: a future plugin that needs another variable must have it added.

reconstruction.problem: plugin_env copies all of os.environ and removes only three denylisted names. STRIPE_API_KEY and SENTRY_DSN reached feed-fetch. Its debug mode dumps its environment to stderr, and a customer pasted that into a public support ticket.
reconstruction.what_breaks: Any secret added to deploy/runner.env that is not on the denylist leaks to plugins. STRIPE_API_KEY and SENTRY_DSN were exposed, and the key had to be rotated on 24 October. The proposed two-name denylist edit would still leak BILLING_WEBHOOK_SECRET.
reconstruction.fix: Replace DENYLIST with ALLOWLIST = {PATH, HOME, LANG, HTTPS_PROXY} plus any TINKERBOX_* name in plugin_env. Add one sentence to docs/plugin-contract.md. Optionally delete the env dump at line 14 of feed-fetch/main.py as well.
reconstruction.cost: A future plugin that needs another variable requires an allowlist edit. The message reports no other readers among the listed plugin dirs. The denylist edit alone costs nothing but leaves the leak open.

reader.closing_answer: Yes, I approve the allowlist in runner/spawn.py with the docs/plugin-contract.md sentence, in place of the two-name denylist addition. I also want the feed-fetch env dump removed, as a separate change.
